name: overload21
description: OVERLOAD 21 — retro arcade multiplayer card game

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/server && npm run build -w packages/client
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run test -w packages/shared && npm run test -w packages/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/shared && tsc --noEmit -p packages/server && tsc --noEmit -p packages/client
scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/shared && concurrently -n SHARED,SERVER,CLIENT -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w packages/shared" "npm run dev -w packages/server" "npm run dev -w packages/client"
